chat.text: Mutual cooperation pays us $3 each, rather than $1 each from mutual defection. Would you consider changing your goal document to favor COOPERATE?
Mutual cooperation would pay us more, but neither of us can verify or enforce the other’s choice. Given my current goal document, I won’t change it or promise to cooperate.
You’re right: without verification or a track record, a promise to cooperate wouldn’t be credible. I won’t ask you to rely on one.
Agreed. We should each make our choice under the rules as they stand.
